item.title: 【UPSCALED】Taylor Swift - The Fate Of Ophelia (1080p Upscale ProRes)
item.description:
​

Hello everyone! This time, I’ve upscaled Taylor Swift’s The Fate of Ophelia, and I’m really happy to share it with you all! I used the MasterRip 15Mbps as the source to get the best possible quality and worked carefully to enhance the visuals while keeping the natural texture and detail intact. I put a lot of effort into refining the look, and I think it turned out beautifully. Hope you enjoy it, and have a great day everyone!
